title: contractTableCells
responsibility: Words a contract table row shows for a field: its requirement, its recorded default as source text, and its name split at dots.

inputs.name: requirementLabel.field
inputs.description: The field record passed to requirementLabel. Its requiredness is reported only when its required member is exactly true or false.

inputs.name: defaultText.field
inputs.description: The field record whose own default property, if present, is converted to source text. A missing own default returns null; present values are passed to JSON.stringify and then String if JSON.stringify is nullish.

inputs.name: nameWords.name
inputs.description: The string is split at each literal period, preserving empty segments. No validation or trimming is performed.

outputs.name: requirementLabel
outputs.description: Returns Required when required is exactly true, Optional when it is exactly false, and Requiredness not recorded for every other value.

outputs.name: defaultText
outputs.description: An own default property is converted with JSON.stringify, falling back to String(default) when JSON.stringify returns nullish. It returns null when default is not an own property, and serialization errors are not caught.

outputs.name: nameWords
outputs.description: The substrings from name.split("."), preserving empty segments and all characters other than the split periods. A string with no periods produces a one-element array.
